picks.thesis: Copied from Grok: Silver closed back above $60 Friday (Kitco/USAGold, Oct 9, 2026) and Comex silver futures were up another ~1.5% to ~$61.6 Sunday night, which should lift high-beta silver miner Hecla at Monday's open. Reference close 17.07, 20-day avg volume ~39M.
picks.main_risk: Expected edge vs S&P 500: -2.18% (±2.64%). No company-specific news; invalidated if silver futures give back the overnight gain below ~$60.5 before the open, and CPI Wednesday can hit metals.

picks.thesis: Copied from Grok: Humana's Oct 9, 2026 8-K says 95% of its Medicare Advantage members are in 4+ star plans for 2027 (vs 20% for 2026), worth about $160 per member per month in Stars revenue versus its $115 goal, and it affirmed FY26 adjusted EPS of at least $9.00; the stock rose 11.6% to its highest close since Jan 2024 and analysts have yet to fully reprice 2028 earnings. Reference close 431.87 (AH 438.49), 20-day avg volume ~1.3M.
picks.main_risk: Expected edge vs S&P 500: -2.60% (±3.26%). Humana says part of the 2028 benefit is one-time, and UNH reports Tuesday before the open and can swing the group; invalidated if it loses Friday's 428 low.

picks.thesis: Copied from Grok: FDA approved Teva's WELTRUZA, the first once-monthly subcutaneous long-acting olanzapine for schizophrenia, on Oct 9, 2026 with launch 'in the coming weeks'; the stock rose 4.7% to a 3-month high on ~15M shares (nearly 3x average), and launch notes plus estimate raises can extend it. Reference close 41.10, 20-day avg volume ~5.3M.
picks.catalyst_time: 2026-10-09 approval; launch and analyst notes over the next sessions
picks.main_risk: Expected edge vs S&P 500: -1.88% (±2.96%). A large, slow stock where the approval was expected, so it may already be priced in; invalidated by a close back below 40.

picks.thesis: Copied from Grok: SpaceX's Oct 8-9, 2026 deal to buy up to 14 MHz of 800 MHz spectrum from Grain Management gives Starlink Mobile 'the outline of a real network' (Evercore), and a new terrestrial carrier needs tower leases; Crown Castle jumped 15.6% Friday on ~14M shares (nearly 4x average) to a 3-month high while carriers sold off. Reference close 79.64, 20-day avg volume ~3.8M.
picks.catalyst_time: 2026-10-09 deal reaction; analyst tower-lease notes 2026-10-12 to 10-14
picks.main_risk: Expected edge vs S&P 500: -2.38% (±2.69%). Any SpaceX build-out takes years (JPMorgan sees limited near-term impact), and a weaker carrier base is a risk to tower tenants; invalidated if CCI gives back half of Friday's gain (below ~74) or SpaceX signals a satellite-only plan.

picks.main_risk: Expected edge vs S&P 500: -2.52% (±5.90%). The tower-tenant link is inferred, not stated by SpaceX. If the gap fades the stop sits below the prior close, and weaker carriers (T, VZ, TMUS down 7%) are towers' main customers.
